jobs.description: Skip to content Quicklizard Platform Overview: FROM DATA TO INSIGHTS AND ACTION Quicklizard is a modular pricing platform built for modern retail and brands. It combines a trusted data foundation, explainable decisioning, and controlled execution so pricing teams can model, simulate, and deploy price actions across SKUs and channels with speed, control, and traceability. Elevate your strategy by moving from manual guesswork to intelligent pricing without sacrificing control or accountability. Request a Demo Let’s Chat Core Platform Capabilities The platform is designed for one goal: scalable pricing execution with control and traceability. Harmonized and centralized data model Unified data layer combining all relevant sources of information from product master data to sales transactions, inventory status, competitor prices and behavioral data such as online traffic, on-site and in-store shopping behavior, or external contextual information incl. local holidays and weather data. Advanced analytics & insights Continuous data validation and integrity checks, regular article segmentation, price elasticity estimation, competitor sensitivity assessment, seasonality detection, and demand forecasting and stock prediction. Modular pricing logic and strategies Off-the-shelf AI modules from competitive pricing, revenue maximization or profit optimization to lifecycle pricing incl. clearance automation and dynamic stock-based price adjustments preventing out-of-stock or reducing overstock. Granular business rules & guardrails Ensuring minimum margins, maximum prices, price stability & freeze periods, regulatory compliance, change corridors and psychological price points. Price architecture and consistency Systematic channel steering, product family creation and alignment, price tier structure and pack size architecture, bundle and multipack lineup. Show all The Roadmap to Pricing Excellence Move from manual cycles to strategic automation with a modular roadmap designed for speed. Start with a fast pilot to prove uplift, then scale into a governed enterprise engine with zero black-box risk. Weeks 1 to 4 Discovery and Design We define success KPIs and audit your current status quo. The target picture is established so you have a clear path to ROI by the end of the first month. We connect with the relevant data sources Weeks 5 to 12 The Value Pilot We go live in a select category to prove the lift. This eight-week window calibrates the AI models and demonstrates immediate profit growth before you scale. Weeks 13 to 18 Enterprise Configuration We codify your business rules and margin floors into the system. This creates the unified system of record that governs your entire catalog. Week 19 and Beyond Full-Scale Automation Your teams are fully trained, and the system is always on. Achieve market mastery with 100 percent traceable decision logs and automated execution. jobs.title: Dynamic Pricing
jobs.description: Skip to content Dynamic Pricing Platform OPTIMIZE PRICES IN REAL-TIME ACROSS EVERY SKU AND CHANNEL. Quicklizard’s Dynamic Pricing platform uses SKU-level elasticity, demand forecasts, and competitor sensitivity to update prices in real time, maximizing margin and revenue while keeping full transparency and business control. Request a Demo See How it Works Slow Pricing Leaves Money on the Table Retail pricing is multi-dimensional and fast-moving. Manual updates, static rules, and slow decision cycles create strategic and operational gaps: Missed Opportunities Delayed response to demand spikes, pricing gaps, and competitor moves that leave revenue unrealized and cede competitive advantage. Margin Drift One-size-fits-all rules and delayed markdowns steadily undermine profitability. Operational Overload Teams stuck in spreadsheets and exception handling instead of strategy. Channel Misalignment Pricing inconsistencies between e-commerce, marketplaces, and stores that erode margins and undermine customer trust. Dynamic pricing must be predictable, auditable, and aligned to business strategy, not a black-box experiment. The Quicklizard Solution Real-Time, Explainable Dynamic Pricing Quicklizard delivers an enterprise grade dynamic pricing platform for teams that treat pricing as a strategic discipline. Built to support complex assortments and omnichannel execution, our hybrid AI and rules based architecture combines explainability, speed, and commercial control, so pricing leaders can scale impact without surrendering control. We build SKU-level and cross-SKU elasticity models and demand forecasts that quantify how price changes affect demand by SKU, category, channel, and region. These models generate price recommendations that prioritize incremental profit over volume. The Competitor Sensitivity Index™ measures which competitor SKUs and price moves materially affect demand. It guides targeted responses that protect the margin while filtering out irrelevant noise. Our hybrid pricing engine pairs configurable business rules such as margin floors, MSRP, MAP, RRP, and channel constraints with AI-driven recommendations. It supports fully automated execution within guardrails, hybrid approval workflows, and manual overrides. Staged rollouts with real-time monitoring ensure safe, predictable scaling. What-if simulations and scenario planning let you compare strategies such as competitive pricing, profit optimization, and regional tactics. They measure trade-offs between volume, revenue, and profit so you can validate plans before deployment. Impact at a Glance Quicklizard Dynamic Pricing helps teams capture measurable outcomes: Faster reaction to market events Reduce time to price from days to minutes to capture short-lived demand windows and competitor gaps. jobs.title: Price Automation
jobs.description: Skip to content Pricing Automation AUTOMATE PRICING DECISIONS AT SCALE, ALIGNED WITH YOUR PRICING STRATEGY Quicklizard Price Automation replaces manual price maintenance with a scalable automation engine that runs continuously across SKUs, categories, and channels. AI optimizers run inside your commercial rules and guardrails, so pricing teams define strategy while the platform executes continuously at scale. Customers achieve up to 15% revenue uplift and ~11% Avg profit Increase. Request a Demo Talk to a Pricing Expert Why Manual Pricing No Longer Works Manual spreadsheets and static rules cannot keep pace with the multi-dimensional complexity of modern retail. Relying on slow, manual cycles creates operational bottlenecks that leave revenue unrealized and margins undefended. Scale and Relationship Complexity Manually maintaining millions of SKUs and linked product structures like bundles or variants is slow and error-prone. Volatile Market Signals Delayed responses to rapid competitor moves and shifting inventory targets lead to "stale" pricing and missed opportunities. Omnichannel Friction Disconnected pricing between web, marketplaces, and physical stores erodes customer trust and margin consistency. Compliance Risks Navigating complex regional regulations and manufacturer price floors (MAP/MSRP) at scale is nearly impossible without automation. Price Automation addresses these pressures by delivering an intelligent, scalable, and economically disciplined engine that executes your strategy in real-time. The Quicklizard Solution The Pricing Automation Platform, Built for Control We deliver price automation that pricing teams can trust. This is not about handing decisions to a black box. It is about combining transparent rules, AI pricing optimization, and reliable execution so your strategy is enforced while automation runs continuously. We combine a transparent rules engine (min/max prices, margin floors, channel & legal constraints) with AI optimizers. The AI proposes prices; business rules ensure every recommendation aligns with your strategy and brand. Every recommendation is explainable (inputs, logic, expected impact). Automation is guarded by configurable thresholds, confidence bands and approval workflows, and every execution records model versions and audit metadata. Price Automation executes across e-commerce, marketplaces, and stores (including ESLs and POS). Channel-aware logic (sync rules, channel corridors) prevents conflicts and preserves intended price differences. Pre-built connectors (ERP/POS, Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce), APIs, and secure batch options let teams pilot quickly and scale. Fast pilots (4–8 weeks) validate uplift; enterprise rollouts follow a staged program (≈ 10–14 weeks). Business Impact Impact at a Glance Faster pricing cycles Accelerate time to price and time to market response. jobs.title: Competitive Pricing / Pricing Intelligence
jobs.description: Skip to content Pricing Intelligence STAY COMPETITIVE WITHOUT SACRIFICING MARGIN. Quicklizard’s Competitive Pricing module, in combination with our proprietary Competitor Sensitivity score, constantly analyzes real-time market data and provides clear guidance on SKU-level, which price moves to follow, and which to ignore. So you react only where competitors' moves actually affect demand, protecting margin while keeping you competitive. Request a Demo Talk to a Pricing Expert Limitations of Traditional Competitive Pricing Traditional competitive pricing often devolves into a destructive cycle of constant price matching, leading to steady margin erosion and damaged brand value. Manual monitoring and blunt rules fail to provide the strategic clarity required to navigate today’s complex retail environment. Wrong Attribution Demand shifts are often misattributed to the wrong market drivers without proper controls. Irrelevant Noise Teams struggle to identify which specific competitor moves actually influence their own unique demand. Price Sensitivity Blind Spots Without granular data, it is difficult to determine which SKUs are truly price-sensitive at any given moment. Operational Drag Analysts spend excessive time tracking market fluctuations that do not materially impact financial performance. Pricing teams need a data-driven answer to separate meaningful signals from market noise and react only where it protects profit. The Quicklizard Solution Competitive Pricing, Redefined. Competitive pricing isn’t about matching every move. It’s about shaping price perception on customer critical SKUs (KVIs), and only against the competitors that truly drive demand. Quicklizard identifies those competitors, detects destructive price cycles early, and enables precise, scalable action across complex omnichannel assortments, including branded, private label, and regulated markets with MAP, MSRP, RRP, plus region and channel rules. We collect competitive signals from online and offline sources, marketplaces, price-comparison engines, social marketplaces, flyers, and retailer portals, plus visibility indicators. This continuous feed gives a reliable, up-to-date view of the market, so CSI and optimizers work from current evidence. We collect and harmonize competitive signals from online and offline sources, marketplaces, price-comparison engines, social marketplaces, flyers, and retailer portals, plus visibility indicators (availability, delivery terms). This continuous feed gives a reliable, up-to-date view of the market, so CSI and optimizers work from current evidence. CSI quantifies which competitor price moves change your demand. Combined with SKU elasticity and demand models, CSI lets you measure the real, incremental impact of competitor actions, so you ignore noise, avoid destructive undercutting, and protect margin where it matters. We turn insight into strategy: run what-if simulations, rank response options by expected margin impact, and execute differentiated actions via Price Automation or analyst recommendations. The result is targeted responses (only where CSI and simulations justify action), clearer price positioning on KVIs, and margin protection without needless matching. Business Impact Impact at a Glance Protect margin where it matters React only to competitor moves that actually affect demand, avoiding unnecessary undercutting and margin erosion. jobs.title: Revenue Management
jobs.description: Skip to content Revenue Management OPTIMIZE REVENUE, INVENTORY, AND MARGIN ACROSS THE PRODUCT LIFE CYCLE. Quicklizard Revenue Management combines SKU-level demand forecasting, price architecture, and inventory-aware optimization to set the right price for each item at each stage of its life cycle, maximizing revenue and profit while reducing markdowns and excess stock. Request a Demo Calculate Revenue Impact When Inventory and Pricing Fall Out of Sync Retail revenue management depends on aligned pricing, promotions, and inventory. Revenue management software unifies these signals so pricing decisions stay proactive across the product life cycle. The result: Lifecycle Mispricing Hero SKUs and long tail items require different strategies which must be adapted according to each SKU’s lifecycle stage from listing to delisting - generic and static rules cause margin loss or excess stock. Inventory-Driven Margin Loss Overstocks trigger rushed markdowns, while low inventory leaves margin on the table. Siloed Decision Making Merchandising, pricing, and operations work from different data, creating conflicting actions. No Total Contribution View Teams optimize price or sell through in isolation instead of total revenue, margin, and stock turn. Revenue Management solves this by aligning pricing, promotions, and inventory to maximize lifetime revenue and margin, not short term sales. The Quicklizard Solution Forecast. Optimize. Execute. Our Revenue Management solution optimizes pricing across the product life cycle for large assortments and complex inventory realities. We combine SKU-level demand forecasting, article roles, and price architecture to recommend the right price at each stage, balancing revenue, margin, and stock turn. Role driven lifecycle pricing. Classify SKUs as key value items, sales drivers, and profit generators, then assign lifecycle strategies for when to hold price, promote, and plan markdowns. Role driven pricing prevents blanket rules and aligns decisions to business goals. By leveraging SKU-level demand forecasting, we account for seasonality, promotions, channel mix, and competitor signals. Our inventory-aware models predict sell-through velocity and flag stock-out risks or excess inventory before they impact your availability, recommending price paths that prevent waste and avoid forced clearance. We establish a unified price architecture for your entire catalog by defining price ladders, pack size architectures, and product families. This allows you to optimize total contribution across revenue, margin, and stock turn by setting specific targets for different SKU cohorts rather than focusing on sales alone. We simulate the timing and depth of promotions and markdowns to maximize net revenue based on real time inventory signals. Strategy is translated into action via Price Automation with a continuous feedback loop that uses post action analysis to refine future forecasts and pricing rules. Business Impact Impact at a Glance Higher total contribution Align pricing and inventory to increase revenue and margin across the product life cycle.
